text: China's January-October goods trade surplus reached $1.04 trillion. October exports rose 35.2% year over year and imports increased 41.6%, including a 72% rise in high-tech imports. September retail sales grew 1.1%. Trade surpluses with the U.S. and EU reached $32.7 billion and $33.4 billion.

meta.note: Trade figures cover October or year-to-date periods; retail sales reflect September.

text: SoftBank reported a ¥1.12 trillion fiscal Q2 net loss versus ¥2.5 trillion profit a year earlier. Six-month U.S. data center equipment procurement losses totaled ¥597.2 billion. Vision Fund posted a ¥81.58 billion quarterly loss; cumulative OpenAI investment reached $54.6 billion.

meta.note: Procurement losses cover six months; quarterly earnings and investment valuations use different reporting bases.

text: Anthropic filed an IPO range of $70-$78 for 825 million shares, with a reported 20% retail allocation target. Seven technology companies agreed to a $26 billion private placement at the IPO price. The offering implies up to $1.405 trillion in fully diluted valuation.

meta.note: Pricing and trading dates remain reported plans; the private placement is separate from the registered offering.

text: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth publicly rejected Rep. Thomas Massie's eight impeachment articles and defended his military leadership. The allegations concern war powers, Caribbean strikes, and free speech. A House procedural vote is scheduled; President Trump reaffirmed support for Hegseth.

meta.note: Allegations remain unadjudicated; the House procedural vote and impeachment outcome are unresolved.

text: October CPI rose 0.4% versus 0.3% expected; core CPI increased 0.3% versus 0.2% expected. Food rose 0.5%, energy 0.7%, shelter 0.3%, and transportation services 0.8%. Treasury yields increased and stocks declined. No headline annual CPI rate was reported.

meta.note: Missing October 2025 observations prevent a comparable headline annual inflation rate.

text: The 10-year Treasury yield exceeded 5% intraday before reaching 4.992%, up 13 basis points. The 2-year yield rose over 18 basis points to 4.736%, while the 30-year reached 5.352%, up over 9 basis points. A $42 billion 10-year note auction left dealers with 10% of issuance.

meta.note: Yield figures reflect reported intraday levels; auction allocation is a separate market observation.

text: Nvidia's independent directors retained Joon H. Kim and Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to investigate CEO Jensen Huang and potential exposure of company secrets or national security information. Nvidia shares fell approximately 6% Tuesday. Huang remains CEO during the review.

meta.note: The investigation remains open; the board reports no current reason to believe protected information was compromised.

text: CoreWeave reported Q3 revenue of $3.66 billion, up 168% year over year, and a $709 million net loss. Debt approached $47 billion; revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion. The company raised 2026 revenue guidance to $13-$13.3 billion and reported elevated unsecured borrowing costs.

meta.note: Revenue and debt are reported figures; backlog is contracted demand, while guidance remains prospective.
